question.prompt: Calculate \((2a/b)\cdot(b/(6a))\), where both \(a\) and \(b\) are nonzero. The result is a constant; write it as a fraction in lowest terms.

solutions.explanation: After multiplying the numerators and denominators, cancel \(a\) and \(b\): \((2a\cdot b)/(b\cdot6a)=2/6=1/3\).
solutions.title: Multiply and cancel
